import PV_L2C_DigestRange
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace PV_L2C_OutputDecode
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result AspisR1TerminalDecoder

structure Opening where
  owner : Array U8 32#usize
  salt : Array U8 32#usize
  value : U32

structure Output where
  owner : Array U32 8#usize
  salt : Array U32 8#usize
  value : U32

inductive Error where
  | noteOpening

/-- Owned reference to the wallet adapter's output_note cut. Both native
decoder calls and the first-error order are retained. -/
def run (n : Opening) : Result (core.result.Result Output Error) := do
  let owner ← atomic_statement.decode_digest_canonical n.owner
  match owner with
  | .Err _ => ok (.Err .noteOpening)
  | .Ok key =>
    let salt ← atomic_statement.decode_digest_canonical n.salt
    match salt with
    | .Err _ => ok (.Err .noteOpening)
    | .Ok s => ok (.Ok ⟨key,s,n.value⟩)

/-- The exact successful output, rather than an input normalization premise. -/
theorem success_iff (n : Opening) (out : Output) :
    run n = ok (.Ok out) ↔
      atomic_statement.decode_digest_canonical n.owner = ok (.Ok out.owner) ∧
      atomic_statement.decode_digest_canonical n.salt = ok (.Ok out.salt) ∧
      out.value = n.value := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    unfold run at h
    pv_peel h with owner howner
    cases owner with
    | Err e => cases h
    | Ok key =>
      pv_peel h with salt hsalt
      cases salt with
      | Err e => cases h
      | Ok s => cases h; exact ⟨howner,hsalt,rfl⟩
  · rintro ⟨ho,hs,hv⟩
    unfold run
    rw [ho]
    simp only [bind_tc_ok]
    rw [hs]
    simp only [bind_tc_ok]
    cases out
    cases hv
    rfl
#print axioms success_iff

theorem range (n : Opening) (out : Output) (h : run n = ok (.Ok out)) :
    (∀ x ∈ out.owner.val, x.val < 2147483647) ∧
    (∀ x ∈ out.salt.val, x.val < 2147483647) := by
  obtain ⟨ho,hs,_⟩ := (success_iff n out).mp h
  exact ⟨PV_L2C_DigestRange.digest_success n.owner out.owner ho,
    PV_L2C_DigestRange.digest_success n.salt out.salt hs⟩
#print axioms range

theorem no_raw_P (n : Opening) (out : Output) (h : run n = ok (.Ok out)) :
    2147483647#u32 ∉ out.owner.val ∧ 2147483647#u32 ∉ out.salt.val := by
  obtain ⟨ho,hs⟩ := range n out h
  constructor
  · intro hm
    exact Nat.lt_irrefl 2147483647 (ho _ hm)
  · intro hm
    exact Nat.lt_irrefl 2147483647 (hs _ hm)
#print axioms no_raw_P
end PV_L2C_OutputDecode

import R1Z.PV_RunJoin_HashCallback17
import R1Z.PV_RunJoin_HeadControl29
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace PV_L2C_ChunkStep
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result R1Z R1Z.BuilderForestStdPort

abbrev Iter := core.iter.adapters.enumerate.Enumerate (core.slice.iter.Chunks U32)
abbrev next := core.iter.adapters.enumerate.IteratorEnumerate.next
  (core.slice.iter.Chunks.Insts.CoreIterTraitsIteratorIteratorSharedASlice U32)

/-- Every yielded native chunk strictly reduces the remaining source slice.
This is iterator geometry, independent of any field computation. -/
theorem returned (i j : Iter) (p : Usize × Slice U32) (hs : 0 < i.iter.size)
    (h : next i = ok (some p,j)) :
    j.iter.size = i.iter.size ∧
    j.iter.remaining.val.length < i.iter.remaining.val.length := by
  unfold next core.iter.adapters.enumerate.IteratorEnumerate.next at h
  simp only [core.slice.iter.Chunks.Insts.CoreIterTraitsIteratorIteratorSharedASlice.next] at h
  unfold BuilderForestStd.chunksNext at h
  split at h
  · simp only [bind_tc_ok] at h
    cases h
  · rename_i hn
    simp only [bind_tc_ok] at h
    pv_peel h with n hnum
    cases h
    refine ⟨rfl,?_⟩
    simp only [List.length_drop]
    have hne : i.iter.remaining.val ≠ [] := by
      intro he
      simp only [he,List.isEmpty_nil] at hn
      contradiction
    have hl : 0 < i.iter.remaining.val.length := List.length_pos_iff.mpr hne
    omega
#print axioms returned
end PV_L2C_ChunkStep

import PV_L2C_ChunkStep
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace PV_L2C_HashLoopRange
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result R1Z R1Z.BuilderForestStdPort
open BuilderForestAdmissionPort PV_Src_PortSboxStep
local instance : Fact (Nat.Prime 2147483647) := ⟨R0Z.m31_prime⟩
local instance : ExternalLinear := PV_Src_ExternalReference.dictionary

abbrev callback := poseidon2.hash_fields.closure.Insts.CoreOpsFunctionFnMutPairUsizePoseidon2RoundTransitionTuple

/-- On success, each completed hash permutation restores canonical raw state.
The loop proof covers arbitrary chunk contents and retains failing Result
branches; no field-model projection is used to infer a raw range. -/
theorem success (i : PV_L2C_ChunkStep.Iter) (state out : State)
    (hs : 0 < i.iter.size) (hc : Canonical state)
    (h : poseidon2.hash_fields_with_trace_loop0 callback i () state = ok out) :
    Canonical out := by
  generalize he : i.iter.remaining.val.length = n
  induction n using Nat.strong_induction_on generalizing i state out with
  | h n ih =>
    rw [poseidon2.hash_fields_with_trace_loop0.eq_1] at h
    pv_peel h with result hnext
    rcases result with ⟨o,j⟩
    cases o with
    | none =>
      cases h
      exact hc
    | some p =>
      obtain ⟨hsize,hlen⟩ := PV_L2C_ChunkStep.returned i j p hs hnext
      pv_peel h with sliceIter hsIter
      pv_peel h with enumeration henum
      pv_peel h with absorbed habsorbed
      obtain ⟨expected,hperm,hcan,_⟩ :=
        PV_RunJoin_HashCallback17.permutation (K := ZMod 2147483647) p.1 absorbed
      rw [hperm] at h
      change poseidon2.hash_fields_with_trace_loop0 callback j () expected = ok out at h
      exact ih j.iter.remaining.val.length (by omega) j expected out
        (by rw [hsize]; exact hs) hcan h rfl
#print axioms success
end PV_L2C_HashLoopRange
